status: Research only; no new material map applied yet

sources.qualification: The existing licensed aerial survey was inspected locally for path/lawn alignment; no new facade photographs bundled.

findings: OSM grass polygons align with the main north and south lawn islands in the DOP20 crop.
Service drives and most private footways have no explicit width or surface tags. Widths and finishes require measured aerial interpretation or qualified estimates.
Existing core material atlas ends at Minecraft X=320; the Physics overlay starts north of most reactor approaches.

The ground-renderer ID range excluded all 29 newly built reactor approach tiles (1000061000 through 1000061028). Candidate84 expands the existing range through 1000061299; no new categorical material mask is claimed.
Aerial cars and baked shadows remain on unclassified pavement; adding texture grain alone does not remove them.
qualification: OSM data is ODbL-1.0. Surface classes and path widths are not fully surveyed. This research identifies a future exterior material pass; it does not establish rendered acceptance.
